title: Article 173 — Qualification for membership of the State Legislature

Topic at a Glance
Article 173 of the Constitution of India is titled “Qualification for membership of the State Legislature”. It forms an integral component of The States (Articles 152–237), located within the “The States” cluster. Current through the 106th Constitutional Amendment Act, 2023.

Constitutional Text & Anatomy
